error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the inside terms are not divided by the common factor, the issue is confusing taking out a factor with copying the original terms. Factorising requires the reverse expansion check.

hint_ladder.title: Common factor
hint_ladder.prompt: Look for the largest number that divides both 6 and 9.

hint_ladder.title: Take out 3
hint_ladder.prompt: Divide each term by 3 to see what remains inside the bracket.

hint_ladder.title: Check by expanding
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is taking out a factor but not checking that expanding returns 6x + 9.

hint_ladder.title: Factor-out routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Find the shared factor, divide each term by it, then check by expanding. Use these terms; do not copy.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on dividing every original term by the common factor before writing the bracket.
